item.text: I’m editing the provider APIs now so the request object carries all completion state through the pipeline. That should remove a layer of parameter plumbing and make the interfaces read more like cohesive services instead of utility methods.

The request is now the single carrier for document text and cursor position through the shared completion services. I’m doing a quick reference sweep for stale call signatures and import drift before I stop.

I tightened the completion pipeline so the `SQLCompletionRequest` now acts as the single source of truth for document text and cursor position.

The main change is in [SQLQueryCompletionContextProvider.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G001_dbeaver/plugins/org.jkiss.dbeaver.model.sql/src/org/jkiss/dbeaver/model/sql/semantics/completion/SQLQueryCompletionContextProvider.java:1) and [SQLCompletionProposalProvider.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G001_dbeaver/plugins/org.jkiss.dbeaver.model.sql/src/org/jkiss/dbeaver/model/sql/completion/SQLCompletionProposalProvider.java:1): both APIs now derive script text and completion offset directly from `SQLCompletionRequest` instead of forcing callers to pass those values again. That removes redundant parameter plumbing and makes the shared services more cohesive.

I updated the remaining callers accordingly, including [LspSQLCompletionContextParser.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G001_dbeaver/plugins/org.jkiss.dbeaver.model.lsp/src/org/jkiss/dbeaver/model/lsp/context/LspSQLCompletionContextParser.java:1), [RequestResult.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G001_dbeaver/test/org.jkiss.dbeaver.test.platform/src/org/jkiss/dbeaver/model/sql/analyzer/builder/request/RequestResult.java:1), and the direct provider test [SQLCompletionProposalProviderTest.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G001_dbeaver/test/org.jkiss.dbeaver.test.platform/src/org/jkiss/dbeaver/model/sql/completion/SQLCompletionProposalProviderTest.java:1). `git diff --check` is clean.
